blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines —The Lapu-Lapu City Council passed a resolution requesting the Mactan Electric Company (Meco) to defer electric service disconnection from October until the end of the year. The move aims to provide financial relief and flexible or staggered payment options for consumers unable to pay amid high power rates. This was pursuant to the Consumer Protection Directives of Executive Order No. 110, or the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC). READ: Rotational brownouts?
